info.activity: When you play during the week. The day is split into 4 six-hour slots: Night (0–6), Morning (6–12), Afternoon (12–18), Evening (18–24). Brighter cell = more time. Tap a cell for details.
info.trend: Playtime across successive periods. Bucket size depends on the selected range: daily / weekly / monthly. Tap a point to see its value.
info.genres: A game usually has several genres, so each session counts toward every one of them. Bars show what you play most — they do not add up to 100%.
info.themes: Same as genres: a game has multiple themes, so sessions count toward each. This ranks common themes; it is not a percentage split.
info.decades: Playtime grouped by the game's release decade — which eras the games you play come from.
